_comment: Manual comparison cases. 'qgis' = what to set in PST for QGIS (Vector > PST). 'layer' = the QGIS layer that receives the result columns and must be exported to CSV with its id field. 'rpst' = R code, evaluated by run-rpst-cases.R with the layers of data/pst-qgis-test.gpkg available as sf objects, returning a named list of numeric vectors in layer row order; each name is the column name the plugin writes (see MAPPING.md, 'Column names'). Column names are computed from the plugin's naming rules (columnnaming.py); if your QGIS export differs, fix the name in this file, do not edit the exported CSV.

cases.title: Angular Choice, unrestricted, length-weighted and unweighted, all four normalisations
cases.qgis: Angular Choice. Weights: tick 'Length' and 'No weight'. Normalisation: tick none, Turner (NACH-style 'T'), Standard ('S') and Syntax ('C'). Radius: none. Leave angle settings at their defaults (threshold 0, precision 1).
cases.rpst: sg <- segment_graph(layers$segment); u <- function(n) angular_choice(sg, weigh_by_length = FALSE, normalization = n); w <- function(n) angular_choice(sg, weigh_by_length = TRUE, normalization = n); list(AC = u('none')$choice, ACT = u('turner')$normalized, ACS = u('standard')$normalized, ACC = u('syntax')$normalized, ACwl = w('none')$choice, ACwlT = w('turner')$normalized, ACwlS = w('standard')$normalized, ACwlC = w('syntax')$normalized)
cases.note: ACwlC is the column that exposed the weighted-syntax mismatch: the plugin divides by total_depth_weight.

cases.title: Angular Choice, walking radius 250, length-weighted, non-default angle settings
cases.qgis: Angular Choice. Weights: Length only. Normalisation: none and Syntax. Radius: walking 250. Angle threshold 15, angle precision 3 (the weighted branch forwards both).
cases.rpst: sg <- segment_graph(layers$segment); r <- analysis_radius(walking = 250); a <- angular_choice(sg, r, weigh_by_length = TRUE, normalization = 'none', angle_threshold = 15, angle_precision = 3); s <- angular_choice(sg, r, weigh_by_length = TRUE, normalization = 'syntax', angle_threshold = 15, angle_precision = 3); list(ACw250wl = a$choice, ACw250wlC = s$normalized)

cases.title: Unweighted Angular Choice with non-default angle settings: compare against the settings the plugin ACTUALLY passes
cases.qgis: Angular Choice. Weights: No weight only. Normalisation: none and Syntax. Radius: walking 250. Enter angle threshold 15, angle precision 3 in the dialog.
cases.rpst: sg <- segment_graph(layers$segment); r <- analysis_radius(walking = 250); a <- angular_choice(sg, r, weigh_by_length = FALSE, normalization = 'none', angle_threshold = 0, angle_precision = 1); s <- angular_choice(sg, r, weigh_by_length = FALSE, normalization = 'syntax', angle_threshold = 0, angle_precision = 1); list(ACw250 = a$choice, ACw250C = s$normalized)
cases.note: Source reading says the unweighted branch does not forward the dialog's angle settings (angularchoiceanalysis.py l.154-161), so the plugin uses threshold 0 / precision 1. rPSTool honours supplied settings (a deliberate difference); this case therefore passes the plugin's effective values. If the manual run shows the plugin DID use 15 / 3, rerun with those values and report it.

cases.title: Network Integration, steps radius 2, with node count and total depth
cases.qgis: Network Integration. Radius: steps 2. Extra outputs: node count (N) and total depth (D).
cases.rpst: g <- axial_graph(layers$axial); r <- network_integration(g, radius = analysis_radius(steps = 2)); list(Is2 = r$integration, Is2N = r$node_count, Is2D = r$total_depth)

cases.title: Reach, steps radius 2: count, length, area in square metres
cases.qgis: Reach. Radius: steps 2. Outputs: reached count, reached length, reached area (convex hull) in m2.
cases.rpst: g <- axial_graph(layers$axial); r <- network_reach(g, radius = analysis_radius(steps = 2)); list(Rs2N = r$reached_count, Rs2L = r$reached_length, Rs2am = r$reached_area)
